question: In a certain code language, ‘PARENT’ is written as ‘148’ and ‘WRANGLE’ is written as ‘160’.How will ‘GRANTED’ be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9b750f6c904cab86cf5cfdc4bfd5c933fca17392b1cf29a1d418dffc6cc08ac.png] 

**Logic:- **(Addition of the place value of alphabet) × 2 = code

1) 'PARENT' is written as "148"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47986184dbdb2ca47b5962970de7d002e2a1b37e4afcb47460dcfc81c324671c.png] 

and, 

2) 'WRANGLE' is written as** **'160' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f9b73af8a4fb6556ac8fe1e62a7c8c7079f32d5384fba9055274df1793cf7b6.png] 

Similarly,

3) 'GRANTED'** **is written as (?)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b506f234a6bddc294dd514dd4b1ffacbef536c5d4594c4014e54462e6199c95.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"138"**
